# AI storyboard to video: previz in three.js or Blender before you pay

**Turn a script into an approved storyboard and a 3D previz with real cameras, then the reference for Seedance 2.5 video-to-video.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-mockups`: ~$0.06–0.08 per Nano Banana 2.1 still, ~$0.23 per GPT Image 2.5 high-quality still. Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `threejs-animatic`, `code-to-video-previz`.

**Short answer:** start with [`varg-previz`](../../varg-previz/README.md): story, character and product sheets, master plates, a three.js grey-box previz with auto cameras, Seedance video-to-video packs. The other 4 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-mockups --skill varg-previz --skill threejs-animatic --skill code-to-video-previz --skill video-animate
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Storyboard my 30-second ad script as a board of stills I can approve frame by frame: ./script.md"*

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Storyboard my 30-second ad script as a board of stills I can approve frame by frame: ./script.md"
- "Make a three.js animatic of these 8 storyboard shots timed to ./track.mp3, with a lens and camera move per shot."
- "Copy the camera of this reference shot in 3D and hand it to Seedance: ./ref.mp4"
- "Turn my approved previz into Seedance 2.5 video-to-video shots, 480p drafts first."

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-mockups`: ~$0.06–0.08 per Nano Banana 2.1 still, ~$0.23 per GPT Image 2.5 high-quality still.
- `video-animate`: ~$0.64–3.42 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 clip, 480p–1080p (estimate).
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can AI make a storyboard from my script?

Yes. varg-mockups makes one self-contained HTML storyboard board with numbered frames, shot specs, prompts and approve / needs-fix / reject per frame; the stills come from Nano Banana 2.1 or GPT Image 2.5 and stay consistent (character sheets, environment master first).

### What is a previz and why bother?

A schematic 3D version of every shot with a real camera. threejs-animatic fixes camera, geography, scale and timing for free before the paid step, and shows every camera frustum on a top-down set map for review.

### How does the animatic become AI video?

It is rendered to MP4 frame by frame (headless Chrome or HyperFrames) and used as the @video1 reference for Seedance 2.5 video-to-video on varg, so the generated shots keep the approved camera and blocking.

### Three.js or Blender?

code-to-video-previz decides if a shot needs a 3D prototype at all and which tool fits; the same scene file renders in Three.js and headless Blender.

### Do I need npm or a 3D artist?

No. threejs-animatic ships a working starter project with no npm, and varg-previz makes auto cameras from plain storyboard words like 'MCU, 3/4 left, push in'.
